posts.community: Harshdeep Hortico Ltd (SME) - A Microcap Opportunity in India's Growing Gardening & Outdoor Lifestyle Market
posts.text: Came across an update that TrueGarden has opened a new showroom in Surat and is an authorised dealer of Harshdeep Hortico. Surat looks like a potentially interesting market for Harshdeep’s products. With its urban residential market, there could be opportunities in balcony gardening, decorative planters, indoor plants and home décor. There may also be opportunities to supply larger planters to offices, commercial establishments, landscapers and interior designers. What I find interesting is the distribution angle.
